BJP Observes Sardar Patel's Birth Anniversary with Unity Pledge

The Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP) observed the birth anniversary of Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel by offering floral tributes and taking a pledge for national unity. In Katni, an 'Ekta Daud' (unity run) was organized on the occasion, conveying messages of brotherhood and patriotism.
